concept.title: Review task header
concept.shortdesc: Use the review task header to view task details, check status, and access actions such as sharing, viewing owners, and requesting re-review.

conbody.p: When a review task is open, the review task header remains available no matter which page you open inside the task. This keeps the main navigation options and the breadcrumb available at all times.

section.title: Header overview
section.p: The top part of the header contain the review task name along with the general shortcuts to the application home screen, to the list of projects and review tasks, access to user profile and the help menu.

The lower part of the header changes depending on the page context and your role in the task. It can show the task name, the review status, the task owners, the number of reviewers who have finalized the task, and the due date, if a due date is configured in the task settings page. You can click the three-dots More details control to the left of Share to see additional information such as the creation time for all task types and the current branch for project review tasks.

section.title: Review status information
section.p: The header includes review status information for the current user, as described in .

For owners, that is the review status infromation. For reviewers that includes the review status information, that presents the review state relevant for reviewers, and optionally the individual reviewer status, if the reviewer marked the task as finalized.

section.title: Workflow actions
section.p: The header can include one or two workflow action buttons next to the review status. The available actions depend on your role and the current task state. In some states, you can move the task forward in the workflow or return it to a previous state. For example, task owners can see actions such as Close review, Reopen review, or, for project tasks, Start integration. Reviewers can see Finalize my review. For details, see Review Task States and Status.

section.title: Owners
section.p: You can click the Owners widget to see information about the task owners. If you are an owner, the widget will show also an action to add additional owners.

section.title: Reviewer Status widget
section.p: The individual reviewer status information is shown in a widget that provides an overview of how many reviewers finalized the review. Click the widget to open a list of the individual reviewer status information for each assigned reviewer. The status can be Pending, In progress, or Finalized. If a reviewer makes more changes after finalizing, the status changes back to In progress. These statuses remain visible after the task moves past the In review state, but they are reset when the task owner starts a new review cycle.

section.title: Start a new review cycle
section.p: If at least one reviewer has Finalized their review, the task owner can use the Request re-review button to reset the individual review status for all reviewers and start a new review cycle. If the task owner reopens a closed task, the individual review status is also reset for all non-pending reviewers to In progress.

section.title: Share action
section.p: If you are a task owner, the Share action is available in the task header, you can click Share to configure access to the task. See for details.
